title: Courtesy Discount on Paid Tune-Ups — Repair and Emergency Service Calls Billing Standard
content:
**Tune-up lines.** On Repair and Emergency Service Calls, a customer enrolled in the senior, military veteran or first responder courtesy program receives the courtesy rate on a paid tune-up line. It is posted as one courtesy discount line naming the tune-up line and the customer's agreement. Enrollment in the program is read from the customer's profile.

**Which lines qualify.** The paid tune-up line qualifies in every call class where the courtesy program applies, because no member repair discount ever applies to it. On repair lines the courtesy program percentage still applies only to a line that receives no member repair discount, or in place of the member repair discount when the courtesy percentage is higher. Fees, premiums, refrigerant and late-payment charges never qualify.

**Courtesy rate.** The courtesy rate is the call class's courtesy program percentage, as listed for the class.

**Amount.** The tune-up courtesy discount is the tune-up line's charged amount multiplied by the courtesy rate, rounded once to the cent half up. An amount that falls exactly halfway between two cents is rounded up to the higher cent; for this purpose an amount within 1e-09 of a dollar below the half cent counts as exactly halfway.

## Which lines qualify

| Line on the invoice | Courtesy discount |
|---|---|
| Paid tune-up line, in a class where the courtesy program applies | Yes, at the courtesy rate |
| Repair parts or labor line with no member repair discount | Yes, at the courtesy program percentage |
| Repair line whose member repair discount is lower than the courtesy percentage | Courtesy percentage, in place of the member discount |
| Diagnostic fee, after-hours premium, refrigerant, late-payment charge | Never |

## Worked examples (hypothetical calls, courtesy-program customers)

| Call | Tune-up line charged | Courtesy rate | Courtesy discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Service Call tune-up | $129.00 | 10 percent | $12.90 |
| Weekend Service Call tune-up | $149.00 | 10 percent | $14.90 |
| Customer not enrolled in a courtesy program | $129.00 | — | None |
